source: Field names from the Codex hooks page (developers.openai.com/codex/hooks) and the notify section of developers.openai.com/codex/config-advanced, read 2026-11-07. Values match session X in codex/sessions.
delivery: Hooks get one JSON object on stdin. notify gets one JSON argument on the command line and only fires for agent-turn-complete.

files.description: notify payload with kebab-case keys: type, thread-id, turn-id, cwd, input-messages, last-assistant-message.
Prompt about to be sent, with turn_id.
exec_command git commit, reported as tool_name Bash with tool_input.command.
Approval request for a Bash command with a description.
apply_patch after it ran; tool_input.command holds the patch and tool_response the model-facing output.
After a model request attempt with status, error and token_usage.
Session ended; reason is always other today.

notes: session_id is the thread id; subagent hooks use the parent session id.
The docs do not give the token_usage shape for PostModelRequest; this fixture assumes the token_count usage shape from session logs.
The documented SessionEnd example has no model field, so this fixture omits it.
